_about: Golden set for POST /api/lords-day/cards (TKL-861). Twelve real handwritten sermon-note pages, photographed by the note-taker on an iPhone and shared for this eval on TKL-861 (2026-11-21); uprighted, downscaled to 1600 px and stripped of all metadata (EXIF/GPS) before commit. Per case: the sermon passage a Verse card must name (OSIS book.chapter), other passages the notes name (recall only, not scored), and key spans: ideas a Key point or Quote card should carry. A span matches when any of its '|' alternatives is a substring of the normalised card text. Written by reading each photo. TKL-1061 adds `sermon` truth (title, preacher, passage, church, serviceDate; null = the notes don't say it) to sermon-12, read from its heading, and three typed-note cases (`typed` instead of `photo`): smyrna-rev-2 (the Revelation 2:8-11 note behind the approved journal prototype, TKL-951, retyped from its heading and points), passage-only and no-heading.

cases.typed:
Revelation 2:8-11 — To the Church at Smyrna
The words of the first and the last, who died and came to life. We are comforted by the supreme place of Christ as both First and Last.
The hatred of the world is part of our heritage with Christ (John 15:18-25).
True union with Christ is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit (Rom 2:28-29).
"Do not fear" is a constant refrain in the Bible. Christ walks among his lampstands; he is with us in his church.
The Devil is behind these fiery persecutions, but we are called to endure his rage. Dan 3:18. God is behind the testing (1 Pet 1:7).
Be faithful unto death, and I will give you the crown of life. The crown is our participation in the victory of Christ over sin, death, hell, and the Devil.
Margaret Wilson: "I see Christ wrestling there."
